packageRules.description: Ecosystem grouping: collapse non-major Python dep bumps into one PR per Renovate run. Placed first so the stack-specific rules below (OpenVINO, PyTorch) can override groupName for the packages they name.
Ecosystem grouping: one PR for all non-major frontend npm bumps.
Ecosystem grouping: one PR for all GitHub Actions bumps, including the digest pins from config:best-practices.
Ecosystem grouping: one PR for base-image / Dockerfile bumps.

Keep the OpenVINO export stack together. openvino is declared twice (pyproject.toml pep621 dependency + requirements/requirements-openvino.txt, which the Dockerfile installs into the container) — group both managers so a bump never lands in one file without the other (PR #223/#224 split: pep621 bumped alone, requirements-openvino.txt bumped in a separate ungrouped PR, leaving the container's install file out of step).
Track CPU Torch packages together and require compatibility review
Qwen package updates can change the custom generation contract
NNCF (currently 3.3.0) pins numpy<2.5.0 in its own pyproject.toml; covers both the pyproject.toml pin (pep621) and the requirements-dev.txt pin (pip_requirements) so neither slips through ungated

pocket-tts is declared twice (pyproject.toml pep621 dependency + requirements/requirements-pocket-tts.txt for the Docker build) — group both managers so a bump never lands in one file without the other (PR #218 only touched pyproject.toml/uv.lock and left the requirements file stale at 2.1.0)

transformers is pinned to the version qwen-tts==0.1.1 was tested against; our OV export wrappers depend on specific internals (DynamicLayer, create_causal_mask). Re-enable when qwen-tts bumps its compatibility baseline. matchManagers intentionally omitted so the rule fires regardless of which manager detects the package (pep621, uv, custom.regex, etc.).

Pin Python to 3.13.x. The blocker for 3.14 is faster-whisper — users report install failures on 3.14 (no wheels/classifiers yet). Everything else in the stack already supports 3.14 (torch 2.13, pocket-tts 2.1, audioop-lts 0.2.2+). To lift this gate: watch https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper/issues/1404 and bump allowedVersions to >=3.13,<3.15 once faster-whisper ships 3.14 wheels. Covers requires-python in pyproject.toml (pep621) and the Dockerfile FROM image (dockerfile).

Pin the actions/setup-python python-version input to 3.13.x in CI workflows — same faster-whisper blocker as the requires-python gate above. Renovate's github-actions manager resolves the `python-version:` input via the github-runners datasource (not a 'python-version' datasource, which the manager doesn't support — that's why PR #222 slipped through 3.13 -> 3.14 despite this rule existing).
